name: Vermeer PD10R pile driver with point-to-point automation
specialisedFor: utility-scale solar construction: driving tracker foundation piles
summary: Remote-controlled tracked pile driver for solar farms with auto-plumb and auto-target; with the optional point-to-point package it uses onboard GPS and the digital pile map to drive itself to the next pile and line up after each pile at the press of a button.

germany.statusNote: Sold through Vermeer's independent dealer network; the EMEA product page has 'Request Quote' and a dealer form that lists Germany. The point-to-point announcement is also on the EMEA site, but no page confirms the PTP package is offered in Europe. No price found.

sellers.name: Vermeer (EMEA dealer network)
sellers.note: 'Request Quote' and 'Find A Dealer' on the EMEA product page; the request goes to the local Vermeer dealership.

specs.label: Remote control
specs.value: wireless remote for hammer, auto plumb and ground drive
specs.quote: Control machine functions, including hammer engagement, pile accuracy using the auto plumb feature and ground drive via wireless remote control.

specs.label: Point-to-point automation
specs.value: GPS repositioning to the next pile from a digital pile map, one button press
specs.conditions: optional package for new PD10R machines
specs.quote: Vermeer PD10R pile drivers equipped with a new point-to-point (PTP) system can reposition themselves automatically using onboard GPS. After driving a pile, the machine operator presses a button and the remote-control-operated PD10R travels and aligns itself to drive the next pile.

specs.label: Operator steps saved
specs.quote: When using this automation technology, operator input is reduced by eight steps

notes: Tracked carrier with a mast and hammer (counted as one tool arm); the photos show rubber tracks and, on the PTP machine, GPS antennas and red bump bars.
PTP models stop moving when a bump bar at either end touches an obstacle (maker).
Without the PTP package the machine is remote-controlled with auto plumb and auto target; a laser receiver and third-party GPS systems can be added.
roughGround and outdoor set from use on open solar-field ground, not from a rated spec.
